metadata.title: Bryan S. Oliveira · Frontend Developer
metadata.description: Mid-level frontend developer from Belo Horizonte, Brazil, working with Vue 3, Nuxt and TypeScript. Experience, skills and contact.

about.label: ABOUT ME
about.title: Frontend developer from Belo Horizonte, Brazil 🇧🇷
about.bio: Hi, my name is Bryan. I'm a mid-level frontend developer who has been building for the web since 2019. Today I work mainly with Vue 3, Nuxt and TypeScript, creating fast, accessible and scalable interfaces with Tailwind CSS, PrimeVue, Vuetify and SASS.
about.backend: I also work close to the backend, integrating with .NET Core (C#) services and APIs and SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases, which gives me an end-to-end view of the application architecture.
about.education: 🎓 I hold a degree in Computer Science and a postgraduate degree in Distributed Systems Architecture, both from PUC Minas, and an IT technical diploma from UFMG's technical college (COLTEC). Along the way I also did Deep Learning research with Python.

highlights: Software development for international clients, mainly in England and Ireland.
Responsible for the frontend of .NET Core projects, using Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and SASS.
Team and project management in Azure DevOps.
Collaboration through pull requests, code review, automated tests and QA.
Petrobras scientific research project in partnership with UFMG.
Implemented and trained convolutional neural networks for seismic image segmentation.
Built Python GUIs for 2D and 3D visualization of seismic data.
Contributed to a review article published in Earth-Science Reviews.
Angular, React, Ionic and React Native, with external API and payment gateway integrations.
Some backend tasks with NestJS, TypeORM and PostgreSQL.
Agile with Trello; version control with Git and GitLab.
Software development for a UFMG health research group.
Angular for websites, Ionic for mobile apps and Figma for UX/UI.
Design Sprints, agile with Trello and Jira, version control with GitLab.
